analysis.narrativeEn:

· Current price ($33.37) vs SMA5 ($33.09)/SMA20 ($33.10)/SMA50 ($33.79): positioned near the middle band for short-to-medium term trends, above SMA5/20, below SMA50.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($32.98)/SMA200 ($31.45): maintaining neutral to positive strength for medium-to-long term trends.
· 52-week position (78.4%) + current price level near historical highs.

· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.0643→0.0713): improvement confirmed, exiting weak convergence zone.

[Volume & Conclusion]

· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): RSI exit from oversold and MACD improvement confirmed, with recovery of the 5-day low meeting buy entry conditions.
